correctness.rationale: With |ε|(8|a|+80|b|)<1 and (a,b) not both zero, h+h′′>0 and h(φ)+h(φ+π)=2. The exact area identity 1/2∫(h²−h′²) and harmonic orthogonality give A(θ)=π−πε²[8a²cos²(3θ/2)+80b²cos²(9θ/2)]/2. Differentiating and factoring gives A′=6πε²sin(3θ)[a²+90b²−120b²sin²(3θ)], positive except when bracket negative. Its minimum is a²−30b² at θ=π/6, yielding the iff threshold, equality with isolated derivative zero but still strict increase, and two sign-changing critical angles otherwise. θ=π/3 cancels both odd modes to a disk; complementary-angle identity follows from cos² complements. The excluded disk (a=b=0) is correctly not strictly increasing.
